data.title: Jodi Sands gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

## [Unacceptable Customer Sevice](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a56c46da4f3c373e953e282)
I ordered the wallpaper on June 28th. Received an email that it would be delivered on July 7th. I still haven’t received the order and it is now July 15th. Emailed customer support on July 13th asking for help to resolve the issue. I have yet to hear from them in regards to the issue. I was supposed to have it installed on July 17th but that obviously won’t be happening. There is no phone number to contact someone for a response, only support from customer service is through email and that isn’t working out well for resolving order issues either. Very disappointed.

June 30, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 15, 2026

Hi Jodi,

Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the delay with the wallpaper. Our Customer support team is currently assisting you with this issue. Thank you for your patience during this time.

Lulu and Georgia
